title: First-Strand cDNA Synthesis and Conventional Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)
author: Izabela M Rezende
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pw9dph6

steps.title: Denature RNA and chill
steps.instruction: Close each RNA tube tightly, place tubes in a pre‑heated 70 °C heat block for 5 min, immediately chill on ice‑water for at least 5 min, centrifuge 10 s in a microcentrifuge to collect condensate, and keep tubes closed on ice until the reverse transcription mix is added.

steps.title: Prepare RT reaction mix
steps.instruction: On ice, combine the GoScript™ Reverse Transcription System components in a sterile microcentrifuge tube, calculating volumes to provide 15 µl per cDNA synthesis reaction; vortex gently to mix and keep on ice prior to dispensing.

steps.title: Add RT mix and RNA
steps.instruction: Add 15 µl of the reverse transcription reaction mix to each RNA tube on ice, then add 5 µl of RNA‑primer mix for a final volume of 20 µl per tube, taking care to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Anneal primers
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a temperature‑controlled heat block equilibrated at 25 °C and incubate for 5 min.

steps.title: Extend cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 42 °C for up to 1 h (temperature may be optimized between 37 °C and 55 °C); reactions may be frozen for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Inactivate reverse transcriptase
steps.instruction: If proceeding to PCR, thermally inactivate the reverse transcriptase by incubating the reaction tubes at 70 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Thaw the GoTaq® Colorless Master Mix at room temperature, vortex, then briefly centrifuge in a microcentrifuge to collect the liquid at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Prepare PCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble one of the specified PCR reaction mixes (details not provided in the source).

steps.title: Centrifuge PCR reactions
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the reaction tubes in a microcentrifuge for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Run PCR program
steps.instruction: Place the reactions in a thermal cycler pre‑heated to 95 °C and run PCR using the standard parameters.
